svg.title: Soil moisture signal flow diagram
svg.desc: Signal flow from capacitive soil sensor through MCP3008 ADC to Raspberry Pi, which branches into CSV log, live graph, and phone notification.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does soil moisture affect electrical capacitance?')
sendPrompt('How does a capacitive soil moisture sensor work?')
sendPrompt('How does the MCP3008 ADC convert analog to digital signals?')
sendPrompt('What does the Raspberry Pi do with the moisture readings?')
sendPrompt('What does the CSV data log contain?')
sendPrompt('How does the live matplotlib graph work?')
sendPrompt('How does the push notification to the phone work?')
